pattern_1.transformation: Skip the second (units) row; parse '%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S' as local Mountain Standard Time (Etc/GMT+7) and convert to ISO 8601 UTC.
pattern_1.unit_conversion: Localize to Etc/GMT+7 (MST, no DST) then convert to UTC.

pattern_1.transformation: Parse float j (meters) from moisture-content column names 'MC_jm' (e.g., 0.1 from 'MC_0.1m').
pattern_1.unit_conversion: None; source depth units are meters.

pattern_1.transformation: Look up 'Northing' for 'site_id' (ID column) in Locations.csv.
pattern_1.unit_conversion: Reproject from EPSG:32613 (WGS84 UTM Zone 13N, meters) to EPSG:4326 (WGS84, decimal degrees).

pattern_1.transformation: Look up 'Easting' for 'site_id' (ID column) in Locations.csv.
pattern_1.unit_conversion: Reproject from EPSG:32613 (WGS84 UTM Zone 13N, meters) to EPSG:4326 (WGS84, decimal degrees).

pattern_1.transformation: Single sensor per site and depth; replicate set to 1 (not encoded in source).
Parse site_id from source filename (e.g., 'TMC1' from 'TMC1.csv'); matches the ID column in Locations.csv.

Coerce from 'wide' format (moisture-content columns 'MC_jm' with depth embedded in the column name) to 'long' format with separate depth and volumetric water content columns. Temperature ('T_*') and electrical conductivity ('EC_*') columns are not part of the target schema and are dropped.
pattern_1.unit_conversion: None; source units V/V are equivalent to m3/m3.
